title: Robot Encodings and Cross Entropy Visualization
full_prompt: Create a Manim visualization demonstrating the concept of cross-entropy and information theory using a robot encoding metaphor. Implement a custom `EntropyChart` class inheriting from `VGroup`. This class must visualize a probability distribution as a horizontal stacked bar (using a custom or simulated `StackedProbDistribution`) where each segment's width corresponds to its probability. Above each segment, draw a vertical bar whose height represents the information content of that event, calculated as $-\log_2(p_i)$ bits. Use `ValueTracker`s to drive the probabilities dynamically, ensuring that as the probability of a segment changes, both its horizontal width and the height of its corresponding vertical information bar update smoothly in real-time. Include a vertical axis with reference lines and labels indicating the information content in bits. The colors of the vertical bars should interpolate smoothly across a gradient (e.g., from blue to teal).

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using Manim Community StackedProbDistribution which might not exist or have different parameters
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure StackedProbDistribution is either custom-implemented using standard Rectangles or correctly imported from manim_imports_ext

common_failure_modes.pattern: ValueTracker updater syntax mismatch between ManimGL and ManimCE
common_failure_modes.note: ManimGL uses inline updaters or add_updater(lambda m: ...) which can behave differently in CE if not handled carefully
